passages.question: Look back at today as if in a clear mirror: which of these qualities did you see in yourself, and which did you not?
Which were the sensual, malicious and cruel thoughts you had? Which were the thoughts of renunciation, good will and harmlessness?
What skillful thought could you have used like a finer peg, to knock out the larger peg of an unskillful thought that arose?
Is there someone you felt resentment towards today? What is one good part of them you could pick out, like the usable cloth in the rag?
What pleasure from seeing, hearing, tasting, smelling and touching did you reach for today? Did it really ease the hunger, or leave you gnawing for more?
Who and what did you spend your time with today? What did that fill up in you?
Think of something you said today. Was it timely, true, gentle, beneficial and loving? Which of the five was hardest to keep to?
When you saw, heard, smelled, tasted, touched or thought of something today, where did you get caught up in its features and details?
Was there someone today you felt ill will towards? Did they treat you as badly as bandits sawing off your limbs? What would it take to keep a heart of love for them, even then?
What decisions did you make out of favouritism, dislike, confusion or fear, in your life so far? How did that pan out for you?
Choose one thing you did today. Looking back, did it hurt you, someone else, or both, or did it lead to happiness? What will you take from it?
When was a moment today when desire clouded the water, so you couldn't see what was good for you or for others? What was it like once it settled?
Where did you wander out of your own territory today? What brought you back?
